Los Angeles has one of the most generous municipal furniture programs in the country: LA Sanitation (LASAN) picks up bulky items — couches included — **free, with no item limit**, for homes and apartments alike. The one rule Angelenos trip over: **you must schedule the pickup before the couch goes outside.** An unscheduled couch at the curb is illegal dumping in LA, even though the pickup itself would have been free.

## The LASAN Program, Exactly

- **Who's covered:** residences served by LASAN — single-family homes and multi-family buildings, including apartments of five-plus units (larger buildings schedule by appointment).
- **How to schedule:** the MyLA311 app, 311, LASAN's Customer Care line at 1-800-773-2489 (24 hours), or the request form at lacitysan.org — **at least one business day before your regular collection day.**
- **When it's collected:** on your regular refuse day, from the curb.
- **The order of operations is the whole rule:** schedule first, *then* place the couch out. LASAN itself asks residents to call before anything touches the curb — and to report items dumped without a request.
- **Bonus option:** LASAN also runs free monthly bulky-item drop-off events at district yards around the city if you have a truck and want it gone sooner than your collection day.

## When the Free Program Isn't the Fit

Three LA-specific gaps: **the carry is yours** — LASAN collects from the curb, and a sectional down three flights of a Koreatown walk-up is not their department; **the schedule is theirs** — the pickup lands on your next collection day, not the day your lease ends; and **a good couch deserves better** — LASAN's own guidance says it plainly: if someone could still use it, donate it first. [Here's what charities accept](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/).

When those gaps matter: [couch removal in Los Angeles](/ca/los-angeles/couch-removal/) starts at $90 with the inside carry included, [same-day in most ZIPs before 2PM EST](/book-online/), and [donation pickup](/ca/los-angeles/donation-pickup/) routes good furniture to local charity partners without you renting a truck on the 405. Item-by-item pricing is in the [cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is bulky item pickup really free in Los Angeles?

Yes — it's included in the city refuse service, with no per-item charge and no practical limit for residential items. The requirements are procedural: schedule through 311/MyLA311 before placing anything out, and the pickup happens on your regular collection day.

### Can I just leave a couch on the curb in LA?

No — without a scheduled request it's illegal dumping, which the city actively asks neighbors to report. The fix costs nothing: make the 311 request first, then set it out.

### Does LASAN pick up from apartments?

Yes. Multi-family buildings of five or more units are covered through scheduled appointments via the Customer Care line — one of the more apartment-friendly programs among big cities.

### What's the fastest couch removal option in LA?

Booked removal on your own timeline — [same-day across most of LA](/ca/los-angeles/couch-removal/) when you book before 2PM EST, carried out from inside your home rather than waiting curbside for collection day.
